page.notes: The first line is a fragment continued from the previous page. The marginal note on the right is printed in roman type. The Latin "Judæo" and "Judæus" are printed with a long-s-like initial and are read as J. Greek and Hebrew: none on this part. The Greek in the margin and in the text is copied from the scan at low resolution; the marked words (αὐτῷ, ᾗ) are doubtful. The margin note's Greek and the ⊙ sign for the Greek ending ος are as printed. The long s is written as plain s throughout, and "Nā" and "medio ꝑ se" are as printed.
